text: disappointed that the restaurant was not open for the two days of our stay. breakfast was as we expected but in a lovely location on the patio not much of a selection

Only stayed one night and would stay there again. Location was nice. Breakfast was ok though could have been warmer and selection of food was minimum. Larger duvet on bed. Heard baby crying in other room numerous times during the night

Short stay in HK. No breakfast. Near flower market and ladies market Central Next to MTR station Near MOKO shopping center Heated pool Easy to get around HK with Uber Some mould in toilet Bed sheets with yellow stains No bed bugs Underwater pool speaker no longer available Pool was a little old

So so but won't come back again. Good location, nearby lots of eateries Hard to locate as it's in between the alley and location on Google map is not accurate. Room is very old and squeezy (the chairs are too huge and heavy to move about to). Toilet is so small and congested. Not even full proper amenities like shampoo and soap were given, very small packet for a long stay. Had to go buy our own. One of the mornings the cleaning staff came in without even knocking and just unlocked our room while we were sleeping. Expensive for this quality of hotel, was expecting much better for this price.

Tolerable for one night stay, over priced for the condition. Good location, breakfast good enough, good shower pressure. Carpet not very clean, bed was very hard and sweaked, no tub for wife, toilet was short and uncomfortable, room a little stale!
The location on the cliff overlooking the Pacific Ocean The small little town essentially shuts down at 5:00 p.m.
Hotel was fine, great location and breakfast but too expensive even if there was a large conference. Breakfast and staff very good, room adequate, very clean. Very expensive via Booking.com
Room shower I was able to book the same kind of suite they jcer by bower for 1/4 of the price and its much nicer washer dryer

Overall not a bad place to stay. Needs some improvement though. The room and bathroom was clean. The beds were comfortable. The microwave in the room wasn't working. The breakfast wasn't great. Can definitely be improved.
Breakfast was very simple.
Location close to Tromsø. The air refreshing system was noisy and not very effective.

Location Great, was functional for one night each time. Location and Bed Room was small and more minimal than I am used to for lesser prices, I stayed on 2 separate dates , first time the TV had no smart apps, was better on second stay.
No hay aire acondicionado …. there is no air conditioning in the rooms there is no air conditioning in the rooms
Holliday Inn Express. Breakfast was good. Liked the balcony. Renovations were under way so paint smell and drop cloths in the lobby. One breakfast machine not working.

The rooms were a nice size. The beds were very comfortable. I didn't like that I drove 300 miles to a hotel with an indoor pool so my son could swim and pool was closed and no discount was offered. If you advertise you have something and you don't your room should be discounted. The other thing I didn't like were the metal door stops, all morning long all you can hear is metal banging and it woke us up it was so loud.

Nice hotel, a bit of a distance to the Old Town. nice hotel with a great view overlooking the bay. Nice buffet breakfast. 2 things. Not enough power points in the bedroom. We had to disconnect the bedsidelamp to charge phone/ipad. It's quite an uphill walk (steep) from the old town. Depending on how quick you walk it's a 15 to 20 minute steep walk back to the hotel.
Pool, comfortable beds, great location, and SUPER nice staff. The bathroom was dirty overall

Stay right on the beach, close to Full Moon Party, good and helpful staff, upgrade of our room, hammock on the terrace, shower on the beach, free towel for a beach, free coffee and tea. Great for a few days stay. This place has so much potential. Old room equipment. Hard to find at first and hard to get there - no road with good conditions.

Great location and comfortable bed. close to the airport, nice washing toiletries, comfortable bed. bathroom layout and position of mirror on bedroom wall is wrong. when you sit on the toilet person on the bed can see you in the mirror. my children were able to watch me sitting on the toilet!!!
Breakfast Elevators
Will cu again x. It's a excellent location and with parking space in front of my room can't ask for more thx Just the fridge was not working but everything seems fine
The studio was very comfortable and all the things was that clean that they look that I was the first one try try them directly from the shop.

Great for a short stay. The Social Hub is in a great location, not far from the city center. As well as that, there are places to have lunch/dinner right outside. The staff were exceptional, every request was met with a friendly attitude. There are vending machines with snacks, drinks and essential items on the bottom floor, which is very convenient, even though the store is a short walk away. The lighting in the room was poor; the window is situated in a way that does not provide sufficient sunlight and the lamps are not making much of a difference. Compared to pictures seen on Booking.com, the way that the room looks is slightly disappointing; the paint on the walls was chipping away and poor lighting was making the mood of the room less cheerful.
It was nice. Breakfast was only few items, on 2nd day it was poor. The location was nice The location, room with balcony facing swimming pool
I loved that it was right in the terminal, couldn’t beat the location for my connecting flight and not needing to pay for transportation to or from the airport.

Perfect for people who want to experience the local life in Jeju. We loved the space and layout of the room. we lived like local. There is kitchenette where you can do some light cookings. We choose a family room with sea views. It’s perfect for people who are not fussy. It’s not new or modern but that’s okay for us.

We loved the view. We paid for sky rooms and one could not stop looking out of the windows during the night. The room was bigger than regular rooms we stayed in during our trip. The breakfast in top floor was very tasty and contained wide selection of food. The hotel is near the subway line which is accesible with JR pass. The hotel equipment was bit outdated however fully functional.

Lovely stay. Comfortable bed and we like the fact it had a curtain which gave more privacy in the dorm. Toilet and shower in the dorm which was nice as again enhanced privacy. We were leaving early the next day and as we arrived off an overnight bus we were able to switch breakfast dates which was appreciated. Great breakfast, you get a lot.

Very responsive to our inquires prior to check-in. Super friendly and accommodating staff, especially Stuardt who gave us local tips and restaurant recommendations. Great location in Palermo, in the vicinity of many restaurants and within 5 mins walk to the subway. No breakfast, but minibar is replenished daily with drinks and snacks at no extra cost. Bad noise isolation, unfortunately we had noisy neighbours who partied through the night.

The place was in great condition. The room amenities were very well done. Good use of space. The room furniture and bathroom were in great condition and very clean. Breakfast was great and liked having access to hot drinks 24/7. Would like a water fountain to refill my water bottle.
